name: Herdr
description: Install Herdr and bridge its pane socket in from the Docker host over SSH

version.description: Select or enter a Herdr version to install

bridge.description: Bridge the host's HERDR_SOCKET_PATH Unix socket into the container over SSH, so hooks/plugins that report agent state can reach it. Needed on Docker Desktop/OrbStack-style setups, where the host's Unix socket file isn't reachable through a bind mount. Requires Remote Login (sshd) enabled on the host and remoteUser set.

remoteUser.description: macOS username to SSH into for the socket bridge. Leave empty to disable the bridge even if `bridge` is true.

remoteHost.description: Hostname of the Docker host, reachable from inside the container

privateKeyPath.description: Path inside the container where the dedicated bridge SSH private key is bind-mounted (see the feature README for how to generate and restrict it)
